name: delivery-metrics
description: Deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate and time to restore, from your own deployment, incident and commit records. Weekly or monthly trends, no dependencies, nothing fetched.

scripts.example: node bin/delivery-metrics.js --deployments examples/deployments.json --incidents examples/incidents.json --commits examples/commits.txt --by week

author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
